name: hunt-cover
description: Skills for AI agents that integrate Hunt Cover: payments, webhooks, Send and Withdraw with human approval, errors and retries, and read only MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate Hunt Cover payments, webhooks and Send
interface.longDescription: Skills that guide an AI agent through the Hunt Cover REST API in Sandbox: Payment Links and Checkout, signed webhooks, safe retries, and Send and Withdraw requests that a person approves in Hunt. The skills never ask an agent to hold a key and never approve money movement.
capabilities: Guide REST API integration for payments
Guide Send and Withdraw with human approval
Guide safe retries and error handling
defaultPrompt: Add Hunt Cover Payment Links and Checkout to my server in Sandbox.
Build a Hunt Cover webhook receiver that verifies signatures.
Show me how to retry a Hunt Cover request safely.
